selection_reason: A new source-assisted clustered-count research task tests marginal-mean theory, misspecified working covariance, numerical implementation, independent review and confirmatory inference together. The existing pinned GEE implementation and R-comparison test provide reusable primary code. This is not a renamed prior task, a reduced GP task, a label-placement pilot or an elementary substitute for complete research.

resource_preparation.preserved_failed_preparation: The first environment inventory inherited outer PYTHONPATH and included ai-statistician. Its isolated probe correctly failed before source execution. Original record and descriptors are retained privately; the unqualified preparation script was corrected to inventory with Python -I. No product mechanism or statistical output was patched.
resource_preparation.boundary: Operator resource and reference checks, not autonomous research or scored qualification. Stored R comparisons are not a new R run. Paper full text returned HTTP 403; original 1986 experiments are not claimed reproduced.

failure_policy: Any failed qualification stays failed with remaining phases NOT_RUN. Do not omit controls, change expected labels, retune prompts, reduce scope, requalify or launch the product under failed authority. No prior task or evaluation is rerun, resumed or rescored.
capability_boundary: The frozen task requires a complete source/theory/code/confirmation lineage and independent final acceptance. Preparation, source execution, controls, tests or optional Lean work alone cannot complete the research goal.
